title: The Frequency theme leans blue: the member background aura leads with sky haze and seaglass, the primary-action gradient runs violet to aqua without its orchid stop, and the site's default and home moods lead with aqua

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: the overall theme is a little too pink; can we bring in more blues to balance?

detail: Three warm-pink leads set the tone: the members root (data-energy="flow") aura opened on --fq-haze (#F7D9C4), the primary-action gradient --fq-pa (every iridescent button, active pill and orb) opened on orchid #EEC1EC, and the site's default and home mood hues led with magenta. In the alias layer the flow aura now runs sky haze, seaglass, then haze; --fq-pa runs the export's own #C4B8FF, #A3D4FF, #8FE9FF stops; --fq-pa-orb trades its orchid for periwinkle. lib/frequency/site-pages.ts leads the default page with violet, aqua, cyan and home with aqua, violet, magenta (stories cyan first). Nothing in design_handoff or the generated core changed.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency.css','utf8'),p=fs.readFileSync('lib/frequency/site-pages.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!a.includes('--fq-aura-1: var(--fq-sky-haze)'))bad.push('the members aura still leads with the pink haze');if(!a.includes('--fq-pa: linear-gradient(120deg, #C4B8FF 0%'))bad.push('the primary gradient still opens on orchid');if(!p.includes(\"hues: ['a', 'v', 'm']\"))bad.push('home still leads with magenta');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-905: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
